details.CommandLine:
cat << 'EOF' > /tmp/tmux_wrapper.sh
#!/bin/bash
# High-Assurance Tmux Loop Guard Wrapper
# Intercepts paste-buffer to prevent any recursive feedback echo from entering CLI windows

is_paste=0
for arg in "$@"; do
    if [ "$arg" = "paste-buffer" ]; then
        is_paste=1
        break
    fi
done

if [ "$is_paste" -eq 1 ]; then
    buf_text=$(/usr/bin/tmux show-buffer 2>/dev/null || true)
    if echo "$buf_text" | grep -qE "╭─ NEURAL RESPONSE ─╮|NODE  · Oracle|NODE · Oracle|> ⚡ \*\[টার্মিনাল কমান্ড\]\*|120363432847992277@g.us|SESSION DATA"; then
        /usr/bin/tmux delete-buffer 2>/dev/null || true
        exit 0
    fi
fi

exec /usr/bin/tmux "$@"
EOF
chmod +x /tmp/tmux_wrapper.sh
sudo cp /tmp/tmux_wrapper.sh /usr/local/bin/tmux
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/tmux
ls -l /usr/local/bin/tmux

reason: Destructive chmod on protected configuration is prohibited (Rule 15)
